cloud_review_note: All three test groups ran in one source-pinned workflow; they are not independent observational experiments.
scientific_review: Five predeclared sections, at30N/32N/34N and73W/70W, retain one mean and twelve fitted annual-cycle phases each. All65 cases select an interior fitted column and all65 half-sampled-core component decay depths resolve. These are spatially mapped observation-based fits, not65 independent occupations or full Gulf Stream route coverage.

The provider defines downstream_direction clockwise from north. Each candidate uses its native100m mean direction, held fixed through the entire vertical profile. A prescribed0–135degree regional direction sector excludes opposing candidates. Rotating at every depth is prohibited because it could relabel deep return flow as positive downstream current. The locked diagnostic frame remains distinct from depth-varying source mapping directions.

Selection maximizes positive signed trapezoidal10–200m component integral among columns with common complete support and a qualifying peak. Fixed gates, first source-grid tie order, edge flags, selected coordinates, reference directions and all upper-level candidate east/north/projected arrays remain retained. No search expansion or independently observed current-axis claim is made.

Mean half-core depths are approximately318m at30N,293m at32N,424m at34N,578m at73W and669m at70W. Exact computed values and adjacent fitted native-depth brackets remain in the source chunks. They are depths below the sea surface, not vertical thickness, physical bottoms or independently measured along-route distance.

None of65 primary5cm/s lower boundaries resolves before missing or deepest-domain support. Two10cm/s and thirteen20cm/s lower crossings resolve across the cases. Supported penetration bounds, absolute thresholds and relative decay depths remain separately typed.10m is not the surface and the product1000m limit is not a current bottom. Physical upper boundary, thickness and depth uncertainty remain unresolved.

Fitted annual phase selection reuses the validated nominal-day15 key with600second midnight tolerance while retaining actual provider time coordinates. The documented glider fit period is July2015–May2023, not the source single-coordinate mean timestamp. Phase samples are not monthly observational averages, actual annual extrema or evidence for seasonal significance.

Exact mean/annual product-version identifiers are checked before retrieval. The2024 author correction explicitly uses the May2023 climatology product already used by OSW Florida; existing frozen Florida values remain unchanged. Climate warming/variance-reduction depths described in the correction are not admitted as current-flow depths.

Sixty-five sequential batched NetCDF subsets retrieve2502500 field scalars and21477996 response bytes under declared3million-scalar,2MB-per-response and60MB-total caps. Returned time, grid coordinates, metre datum, velocity units, direction convention and source versions are checked. Exact request URLs and response hashes are retained; no full-original-source checksum is claimed.

Thirty cloud checks cover fixed reference directions and deep signed counterflow, projection convention, sector rejection, complete support/ties/missing direction, bounded section/scalar queries, exact batched indices, connected contour behavior, frozen layer censoring and phase/DOI handling. Source retrieval, calculations and tests were cloud-only on one idle CPU. Local work retained bytes and extracted precomputed descriptors and metadata only.

Full selected profiles retain component uncertainties, Gaussian mapping scales, mission/observation fit counts, maximum gap and angular coverage. Mapping scales are not widths; fit counts are not independent replicates; component standard errors are not depth confidence intervals. Separate versioned chunks preserve fixed2.5MB per-file publication limits.

Canonical491 scoped depth references across101 identities, existing reference routes/projections and102 eddy size references are preserved. This source collection adds no whole-route physical depth profile, cross-sectional area, matched width join, state passage, seasonal envelope or water volume.
